name: secretrun
description: Keep secret VALUES out of Claude Code. The model handles secret NAMES only; the secretrun wrapper resolves name→value in its own process (macOS Keychain / AWS / GCP Secret Manager), injects it into the child command's env or stdin, and masks the value out of the child's output. Nothing lands in argv, context, or the transcript. Ships PreToolUse/PostToolUse/SessionStart hooks, a model-invoked using-secrets skill, and /secretrun:harden + /secretrun:doctor commands.
